title: Product Manager, AI Copilot
text:
Kestrel Ledger is 45 people building a bookkeeping copilot for small businesses and the CA firms that keep their books. We raised our Series A in March. Today our agent matches GST invoices against bank statement lines and drafts journal entries for an accountant to approve. About 1,200 firms use it every month-end, and the close still takes them too long.

We need a product manager who will own that agent end to end.

What the work looks like
- Sit with accountants in Koramangala and Indiranagar during the last week of the month and watch where the agent gets in their way.
- Decide which reconciliation problems are worth automating next, and which ones we should leave to people.
- Write specs that our six engineers can build from without a meeting.
- Own the extraction test set: 3,000 real invoices, labelled, run before every prompt or model change.
- Pull your own numbers from Postgres. Match rate, edits per entry and time to close are the ones we watch.

You should have
- Three or more years as a PM, or as an engineer who did most of a PM's job.
- Shipped at least one product where a model takes actions, not just answers questions.
- Run customer interviews and changed your plan because of what you heard.
- Comfort writing SQL without waiting for an analyst.

Good to have
- Working knowledge of GST, TDS or month-end close in Indian accounting.
- Ideas about how to charge for an agent: per entry, per seat or per firm.

₹28–38 LPA plus ESOPs. Bengaluru, three days a week in our HSR Layout office. You will report to the two founders.

title: AI Product Manager
text:
Paperkite helps in-house legal teams review contracts faster. Upload a vendor agreement and we flag risky clauses, suggest redlines against your playbook and cite the exact text we relied on. Legal teams at 140 companies in India and Singapore use us. We are 30 people, fully remote.

Here is the honest version of the job. Lawyers are rightly sceptical, and a redline that is wrong once costs us their trust for months. Our models are good on standard NDAs and much weaker on long master service agreements. We need someone who will find out why and fix the product around it.

You will
- Spend a few hours each week with general counsels and contract managers, watching them review real documents.
- Work out which review steps are worth automating and which should stay with the lawyer.
- Build evaluation sets with practising lawyers and decide what "good enough to ship" means for each clause type.
- Make sure every suggestion carries a citation, and that the product says it is unsure when it should.
- Write clear specs for a team of five engineers and one ML engineer.

You probably have
- 3 to 6 years of product experience, ideally on B2B tools for professionals.
- A working understanding of how large language models fail: hallucination, long context limits, sensitivity to wording.
- Experience running user interviews and turning them into product decisions.
- Care about safety and correctness that goes beyond a checkbox.

Bonus points
- You have tuned prompts yourself and kept notes on what worked.
- Any legal or compliance background.

We do not list a salary band publicly. We share it in the first call, and it is competitive for remote roles in India.

- The ability to manage senior stakeholders with competing interests.

title: Lead Product Manager, AI Platform
text:
Lead Product Manager, AI Platform
Wayfarer Maps · Remote (India)

Wayfarer provides maps, geocoding and routing APIs to 7,000 businesses, from delivery startups to banks verifying addresses. We are 500 people. Our next platform adds AI on top of location: address understanding for messy Indian addresses, natural-language place search and route explanations.

You will lead the product for this AI platform and manage two product managers.

What you'll do
- Set the platform strategy: which AI capabilities become APIs, which stay internal and which we drop.
- Own the roadmap across address AI, place search and routing, and keep it tied to revenue.
- Hire and coach two PMs. Give them real ownership and hold the bar on quality.
- Lead across engineering, data science, sales and support without formal authority.
- Keep model cost and latency within budget. Customers call our APIs millions of times a day and expect answers in under 200 milliseconds.
- Make sure every model change is measured against real addresses and queries before release.

What you bring
- 8+ years in product, including API or platform products and at least 2 years managing PMs.
- A record of setting strategy for a technical product and delivering it.
- Strong judgement on cost, latency and quality trade-offs.
- Experience leading cross-functional teams across time zones.

Nice to have
- Experience building business cases and pricing for API products.
- Hands-on experience designing developer APIs.

₹65–85 LPA plus RSUs. Remote within India, with occasional travel to Bengaluru and Delhi.
